Green Atlas includes dxf-viewer 1.0.44, by Artyom Lebedev and contributors.
Upstream: https://github.com/vagran/dxf-viewer
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0).

The source archive, MPL license and Green Atlas modifications are available
next to this notice:
  dxf-viewer-1.0.44.tgz
  MPL-2.0.txt
  dxf-viewer-1.0.44.patch

Unpack the archive, then run from its package directory:
  git apply ../dxf-viewer-1.0.44.patch

Modified covered files (15 September 2026):
  src/BatchingKey.js
  src/DxfScene.js
  src/DxfViewer.js
  src/TextRenderer.js
  src/index.d.ts

Changes preserve explicit nested entity layers, resolve layer 0 and
BYLAYER/BYBLOCK through INSERT contexts, keep independent parent visibility
gates and add a bulk ShowLayers API with one render per update.
Batch keys retain line/fill/text appearance classes through flattening and
instancing. Scene objects expose dxfLayer/dxfAppearanceClass metadata.
The existing fragment shader gains an opacity uniform, defaulting to 1.
This enables application-owned material variants without changing source
geometry or treating text glyph triangles as CAD fills.
These modifications to MPL-covered files are made available under MPL-2.0.
Original notices and embedded dependency licenses are retained in the archive.

The original archive is also available from:
https://registry.npmjs.org/dxf-viewer/-/dxf-viewer-1.0.44.tgz
